description: Scrape Google web, news, image and video results with country/language targeting, time filters, operators and optional AI Overview or real destination URLs.

countryCode.description: Country for the Google domain and searcher-location (gl) signal. Leave empty for US (google.com); if Precise Location is set and this is empty, the country is derived from it.
countryCode.title: Country

csvFriendlyOutput.description: For web search, output one organic/paid result per row instead of one SERP page per row. Other SERP features are not included in this layout.
csvFriendlyOutput.title: CSV friendly output (one result per row)

dateFrom.description: Only include results published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be used with Date to.
dateFrom.title: Date from

dateTo.description: Only include results published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be used with Date from.
dateTo.title: Date to

exactPhrase.description: Wrap each query in quotes so Google matches it as an exact phrase.
exactPhrase.title: Exact phrase match

excludeTerms.description: Words to exclude, comma- or space-separated, e.g. jaguar, cats.
excludeTerms.title: Exclude terms (-word)

fileType.description: Restrict results to a file type, e.g. pdf, doc, xls. Sent to Google as-is.
fileType.title: File type (filetype:)

includeAiOverview.description: Opt-in browser-rendered AI Overview for web searches. Slower and not guaranteed: Google may not show one, and the text is best-effort. Only applies to web search.
includeAiOverview.title: Include AI Overview (slower, best-effort)

includeDestinationUrl.description: Add a destinationUrl field with the real destination behind Google's redirect link. Adds one lookup per organic result. Only applies to web search.
includeDestinationUrl.title: Resolve real result URLs

includeExtraBoxes.description: For web search, also extract weather, time zone, currency/unit converter, stock, jobs, videos, shopping and dictionary boxes when present.
includeExtraBoxes.title: Include extra info boxes

intext.description: Restrict results to pages containing this word in the body text. Sent to Google as-is.
intext.title: Word in text (intext:)

intitle.description: Restrict results to pages containing this word in the title. Sent to Google as-is.
intitle.title: Word in title (intitle:)

inurl.description: Restrict results to pages containing this word in the URL. Sent to Google as-is.
inurl.title: Word in URL (inurl:)

languageCode.description: Language of Google's own interface, e.g. en, de, fr, es. This does not restrict the language of the matched pages.
languageCode.title: Interface language (hl)

maxPagesPerQuery.description: Result pages to crawl per query for web, news and videos. Images are a single page. Web results stop at Google's own ceiling of roughly 7-10 pages.
maxPagesPerQuery.title: Max pages per query

maxResults.description: Maximum items to return per query. Web results stop at Google's own ceiling of roughly 70-100; images return 50-100 per query and news/videos paginate in pages of 10.
maxResults.title: Max results per query

queries.description: Google search queries. Each is searched separately; blank entries are dropped with a warning.
queries.title: Search Queries

restrictResultsCountry.description: Only return pages whose content originates from this country (Google's cr parameter), independent of Country/gl. Leave empty for no restriction.
restrictResultsCountry.title: Restrict results to country (cr)

restrictResultsLanguage.description: Only return pages written in this language, e.g. en or en,fr for either. Leave empty for no restriction.
restrictResultsLanguage.title: Restrict results language (lr)

safeSearch.description: Filter explicit content (safe=). Leave empty for Google's default.
safeSearch.title: SafeSearch

searchType.description: Which Google surface to scrape: web organic results, news cards, images, or videos.
searchType.title: Search type

site.description: Restrict results to this domain, e.g. nike.com. Every organic result is checked against it; off-domain results Google slips in are dropped.
site.title: Site (site: operator)

timePeriod.description: Filter results by relative time. Leave empty for any time.
timePeriod.title: Time period

uule.description: Optional Google-encoded location for city-level targeting. Best-effort: country targeting is reliable, city precision is not guaranteed. Leave empty to use Country only.
uule.title: Precise location (uule)

title: Google Search Results (SERP) Scraper Input
